faq.q: Can a Langley townhome have a secondary suite?
faq.a: The Township's current bylaw definition says yes, with a conflict to know about: Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, s.102 (as amended July 2025) permits a secondary suite within a townhouse, capped at 120 m² gross floor area, one per principal dwelling unit — while the Township's January 2025 guide states suites are not permitted in townhouses. In Langley City, Zoning Bylaw 2025, No. 3300 caps a suite at the lesser of 100 m² and 40% with owner-occupancy required. Strata bylaws and permits for the specific unit still govern in practice (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).
